minutes.basis: intake planning model under the new-course budget rule (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, Reading time): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 is the intake target for a Reading page (6 minutes) and modeledWorstPath adds 2.5 minutes for the worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit; course-1 measured worst-path gaps were 2.41-2.65 minutes above P50). budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) = 9. The integration-and-observability module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator P50 (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and keeps budget at least ceil(max(P50, worst path)) and at most 15; T14 then checks the day totals. See authoring/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
